I can’t identify a line to change without the error output, input file, and importer code. Send those three items so the failure can be traced to a specific line.

The queue retains a job until explicit acknowledgement; a lease controls when another worker can take it.

1. **Capacity is 100 jobs.** This sets the queue’s limit.
2. **Jobs beyond capacity are rejected.** Rejection makes the capacity failure visible instead of silently losing jobs.
3. **A running job has a 30-second lease.** The lease limits how long a worker can hold a job without renewal.
4. **Workers renew every 10 seconds.** Renewal keeps the lease active while work continues, with renewals scheduled more frequently than the 30-second lease duration.
5. **An expired lease makes the job available again.** Expiry lets another worker take a job whose lease was not maintained. It does not remove the job.
6. **Handlers must be idempotent because a job can run twice.** Repeating a job must not produce additional unintended effects. Lease expiry and reassignment can lead to a second run even if the first run already did work.
7. **Only explicit acknowledgement removes a job.** Renewal maintains the lease, and expiry makes the job available again; neither removes it. Completing the handler’s work without acknowledgement leaves the job subject to another run after lease expiry.
